messages:
Mina: Heads up — bringing up a converted Qwen->Gemma checkpoint and seeing divergence across hosts after ~12 tokens. Deterministic on one machine, different on another. Suspect QKV projection ordering or an interleaved-rotary frequency mismatch. Anyone seen warmstart kvcache / proj-order gotchas?

Kai: I have. First things: dump state_dict keys/shapes (q/k/v proj) and rotary freq table. Often converters leave blocks in qkv interleaved order. Quick check: 
```python
for k,v in sd.items():
    if any(x in k for x in ['q_proj','k_proj','v_proj']):
        print(k, v.shape)
```

Oliver: Also check head_dim ordering and whether rotary tables were pre-interleaved per-head. Some Qwen variants pack heads differently (head-first vs headwise). If freq table axis swapped you get token offset phase drift.

Mina: I ran our converter (convert_qwen_to_gemma.py) with default flags. Log excerpt: 
```
loaded weights: transformer.h.0.attn.qkv.weight (3072, 1024)
expected layout: q,k,v blocks contiguous but downstream code expects q then k then v as separate tensors
```
Model runs but attention scores collapse after 12 tokens (softmax -> near uniform).

Kai: That collapse screams q/k mismatch. Try a runtime patch that reshapes/slices qkv into (3, heads, head_dim) and permutes axes to expected layout before matmul. Example: 
```python
qkv = qkv.view(3, heads, head_dim, -1)
# swap if converter used [head,3,dim] vs expected [3,head,dim]
q,k,v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
```

Oliver: Also verify tokenizer sentinel mapping — Qwen sometimes maps special sentinel tokens into out-of-band ids that change KV alignment for prefix caching. If host B has a different tokenizer build, early tokens shift attention pattern. Quick: compare tokenizer.encode("Hello") between hosts.

Mina: Ran the qkv-permute at runtime, and bingo — outputs now match across hosts. Sample seed=42 text now identical for 128 tokens. So converter left qkv in an interleaved-packed layout that our Gemma loader didn't handle.

ci-bot: deploy: model-conversion-2026-03-15 finished for conversion job id conv-3321 :white_check_mark:

Kai: Great find. Two followups: 1) add a converter flag --reorder-qkv that produces the loader-friendly layout, 2) add a unit test in model-onboard-evals that loads converted checkpoint and compares generation with reference oracle (seeded).

Oliver: I'll draft a tiny test harness that runs on cpu/gpu and checks first 32 tokens equality and attention-score-statistics (mean/std). Also add a tokenizer checksum test to fail fast if token ids differ across envs.

Mina: I'll open PR with converter patch + token-check. PR will include a small binary check of rotary table shapes and explicit reordering. Will post link once ready. Thanks for quick triage :thumbsup:

Kai: Nice. Can we also add a short note in onboarding playbook: "watch for interleaved qkv and per-head rotary packing when converting from Qwen-like formats"? Saves future hair.

Mina: Yup — adding to docs/ on-boarding checklist and to the conversion README.

Oliver: +1. Glad it was just layout and not a new numerical regression.

Mina: filing followups: conv-3321 patch, onboard-test-187, doc-note-rotary-qkv.
